parts.premise: Unfortunately, the reality looks like this, according to a study published in the American Journal of Family Therapy: A survey of more than 1,100 parents of English- and Spanish-speaking students in kindergarten through grade 12 found that first grade children spent roughly 28 minutes a night on homework; second graders, nearly 29 minutes; and kindergarteners suffered through about 25 minutes of homework each night.
parts.hypothesis: First graders were doing 28 minutes of homework.
